motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Default for border, background, and transform state changes.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Post-load content fade + 6px rise, once (.settle). Guarded by prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: route-fade
motion.purpose: Cross-fade on route change (.route-fade), keyed by pathname.

motion.name: load-floor
motion.purpose: Minimum time a first data load holds its loading state (withMinDuration). A floor, not an added delay.

motion.name: orbit
motion.purpose: WalletOrbit rotation. Guarded by prefers-reduced-motion (stops, not restyled).

components.name: Primary Button (dashboard)

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: block; width: 220px; padding: 15px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: #6366f1; color: #fff; font: 600 15px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4f46e5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar (mobile)
components.description: Below 768px the sidebar is replaced by this fixed bottom bar of the four primary routes. Icon over 12.5px label; active route in Signal Indigo with a 2px top indicator.
components.html: DashboardMy Wallet

components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; gap: 6px; padding: 44px 24px; } .ds-empty__icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); color: #8b8b9e; } .ds-empty__title { margin: 0; color: #f4f4f8; font: 600 14px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-empty__hint { margin: 0; max-width: 34ch; color: #8b8b9e; font: 400 12.5px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-empty__action { margin-top: 12px; padding: 9px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 12px; color: #6366f1; font: 600 13px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-empty__action:hover { border-color: #6366f1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }

components.name: Loading Skeleton
components.description: Shimmer placeholder inside a fetching card — replaces an orphan "Loading…" line. Guarded by prefers-reduced-motion.
components.css: .ds-skel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 0; min-height: 216px; } .ds-skel__row { height: 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 25%, rgba(255,255,255,0.07) 37%, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 63%); background-size: 400% 100%; animation: ds-skel-shimmer 1.4s ease infinite; } .ds-skel__row:nth-child(1) { width: 70%; } .ds-skel__row:nth-child(2) { width: 100%; } .ds-skel__row:nth-child(3) { width: 85%; } .ds-skel__row:nth-child(4) { width: 60%; } @keyframes ds-skel-shimmer { 0% { background-position: 100% 50%; } 100% { background-position: 0 50%; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skel__row { animation: none; } }

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(23,23,37,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 20px; padding: 28px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.35), transparent); } .ds-card__label { margin: 0 0 6px; color: #8b8b9e; font: 500 12.5px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card__figure { margin: 0; color: #f4f4f8; font: 700 32px/1.1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Sterling Crypto Bank is a trading floor with the volume turned down. The surface is a near-black indigo canvas lit only by two soft glow blobs drifting behind everything; frosted glass panels float over it, each caught by a single hairline of light along its top edge. Nothing on screen competes with the numbers. Chrome recedes, color is rationed, and the eye lands on a balance figure or a price delta because that is the largest, brightest thing in view.

The controls read like instruments, not toys. Borders are crisp single-pixel strokes, focus is a quiet border-shift rather than a glow, transitions are short and matter-of-fact (0.15s), and fills are flat --accent — the gradient buttons and accent-glow shadows of the first draft have been retired. Two continuous motions survive as signature, not decoration: the swap control's 180° flip and the wallet's slow orbit, both guarded by prefers-reduced-motion. The direction stays calm: flat fills, diffuse depth, restraint.

Depth is atmospheric. It comes from translucency, a 24px backdrop-blur, and the colored haze behind the glass — never from hard shadows. A card at rest looks like it is sunk into fog, not stamped onto paper.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black indigo canvas (#0c0c14) with two fixed ambient glow blobs — indigo top-left, green bottom-right — blurred 90px.
Frosted glass cards: backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%), 9%-white border, a ::before top light-line.
One interactive hue: Signal Indigo #6366f1. Everything else is neutral or a financial semantic.
Green / red carry polarity only; Bitcoin Amber marks BTC, withdrawals, and pending status.
Data-forward: large tabular monetary figures, borderless rules-only tables, minimal surrounding chrome.
Instrument controls: hairline borders, :focus-within border-shift, 0.15s transitions.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Signal Indigo is the only decorative color on any view. Green, red, and amber appear only to carry financial or status meaning — never to add visual interest.

rules.name: The Token Pair Rule
rules.body: Positive is --green (#22c55e), negative is --red (#ef4444) everywhere, feedback text included, with matching rgba(34,197,94,·) / rgba(239,68,68,·) tint fills. Don't reach for the brighter #4ade80 / #f87171 pair; it isn't a second palette.

rules.name: The Figure-First Rule
rules.body: The monetary total is the largest type on its view (26–32px / 700). Every label around it drops to 12.5px Muted Lilac. Hierarchy is carried by the numbers, not by headings.

rules.name: The Atmospheric Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from blur, translucency, and the ambient blobs — never a hard drop shadow. Card shadows are wide and low-alpha; if a shadow reads as a crisp edge, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Radius Scale Rule
rules.body: New work uses one of six steps — 20 / 18 / 12 / 10 / 8 / pill. The working triad is 20px card, 12px control, pill badge; reach for 10px or 8px only to match an existing compact neighbour.

rules.name: The Border-Shift Focus Rule
rules.body: Fields never glow or ring on focus; the 1px border shifts to Signal Indigo via :focus-within, 0.15s.

dos: Do compose every surface from the glass .card over the dark ambient-blob body, and keep the ::before top light-line.
Do keep Signal Indigo (#6366f1) for interactive and brand use only; green / red for financial polarity, amber for BTC / withdrawal / pending.
Do color monetary deltas by sign and use the 15%-tint pill for every type / status badge.
Do make :focus-within border-shift to --accent the single focus treatment, and keep state transitions at 0.15s.
Do hold the layout frame: 1400px max width, 220px sidebar / mobile bars below 768px, 24px section gap, 28px card padding.
Do set the monetary figure as the largest type on its view (26–32px / 700).
Do give every fetching card a CardLoading skeleton and every no-data card an EmptyState — never an orphan Loading / None-yet line.
Do draw icons as inline SVG (currentColor, ~1.1 stroke); the incumbent emoji glyphs are legacy, not the pattern for new work.
Do keep the deliberate feel: floor loads at ~450ms, .settle post-load content in place, and route a money action through ConfirmPanel before it writes.
donts: Don't add a radius outside the six-step scale (20 / 18 / 12 / 10 / 8 / pill); default to the 20 / 12 / pill triad.
Don't use the brighter #4ade80 / #f87171 pair — feedback text is --green / --red with matching rgba(34,197,94,·) / rgba(239,68,68,·) tints.
Don't reach for gradient fills or accent-glow shadows — primary buttons and the swap control are flat --accent, hover #4f46e5.
Don't ship an animation without a prefers-reduced-motion guard (the orbit, the skeleton shimmer, and the swap rotate each have one).
Don't resurrect src/App.css (deleted — unused Vite-template leftovers), and keep favicon.svg on the infinity / chain lockup.
